notes: First release: list BSManager's Beat Saber instances. You choose the instances folder in Settings > Plugins (it defaults to BSManager's usual location); needs Questkeep 0.7.0.

Open launcher: BSManager appears in the title bar's Open launcher menu and starts BSManager.exe (a second folder setting, BSManager program folder, defaults to its usual install location). Needs Questkeep 0.7.0.
